inputs.label: Majora's Mask ROM (USA 1.0)
inputs.help: Your own uncompressed dump of Majora's Mask (USA), N64 version 1.0, or the N64 ROM from the US Zelda: Collector's Edition disc, as .z64, .v64 or .n64.

steps.text: Open Majora's Mask VR from Library > Unknown Sources. In setup, select Choose Majora's Mask ROM, pick the file in Download and confirm. When the extraction ends the app may close; start it again and play. To update later, install over the top. Do not uninstall, or your saves may be deleted.

notes: Releases are all pre-releases. Each release also has a Steam Frame APK (MMVR-Steam-Frame-*.apk) and a Windows zip, which the asset pattern avoids. Optional mods and texture packs go in /sdcard/MMVR/mods or /sdcard/MMVR/texturepacks; not modelled.
